title: Rental Desk Guidance: Extending a Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Rental Authorization
content:
**Rule.** Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, an open rental on an accepted claim is extended when the repair shop confirms a new completion date or documents a parts delay. Each extension carries its sequence number on the authorization.

## Clauses on timing

1. The days an extension adds are fixed only after the rental it extends stands on the rental ledger as an authorization under the claim.
2. The days an extension adds are not settled until every closed partner direct-bill rental on the claim carries an agency payment on the rental ledger.
3. Before the days an extension adds are worked out, every closed rideshare, taxi or transit authorization on the claim must carry a reimbursement entry on the rental ledger.

Each clause is a condition on the days an extension adds. Until the state a clause describes stands on the rental ledger of the claim, those days are not worked out.

## Effect of an extension

Each extension records one entry on the rental ledger of the customer's option. The entry shows the days added, the extension's sequence number on the authorization and the reason it was granted. The days added become part of the days authorized for that rental from the moment the extension is recorded, and the rental agency and the customer can be told the new covered period.

## Tool

The tool is `extend_rental_authorization_97458fea`, an agent-side tool. The representative unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_coverage_id` | Reference number of the rental reimbursement option the rental is paid under, from the rental option lookup for the damaged vehicle | Identifier |
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the named insured, from the customer profile lookup | Identifier |
| `claim_number` | Physical damage claim number of the loss, from the claim or rental ledger lookup | Identifier |
| `authorization_number` | Rental authorization number of the open rental being extended, as shown on its authorization entry in the rental ledger lookup or on the receipt that recorded it | Identifier |
| `extension_sequence` | Sequence number of this extension on the authorization: 1 for the first extension of that authorization, then 2, 3 and so on | Whole number, 1 or more |
| `authorized_days` | Number of rental days this extension adds to the authorization | Whole number of days |
| `extension_reason` | Why the extension is granted | `shop_new_completion_date` when the repair shop has confirmed a new completion date for the repair; `parts_delay` when the repair shop has documented that parts for the repair are delayed or backordered |

## Return

On success the tool returns:
- the word "extended" as the status;
- the reference number of the new extension entry;
- the authorization extended;
- the sequence number recorded;
- the days added;
- the date the extension was recorded (YYYY-MM-DD).

## Sequence numbering (hypothetical)

An authorization extended twice before carries extensions 1 and 2, so its next extension is number 3.
